fusions.name: Drilled Sleight
fusions.desc: A rehearsed grab that deals 7 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flawless Routine
fusions.desc: Tumbles you through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each. Every hit is a critical hit, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Seen Once
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Repetitions
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
